newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour Party widens lead over Conservatives.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour Party widens lead over Conservatives.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has widened its lead over the ruling Conservatives by three percentage points to 51 percent, according to a poll published on Wednesday.
The Gallup rolling poll' in The Daily Telegraph newspaper gave Labour a lead of 21 percent over the Conservatives who now stand at 30.
"The swing towards Labour since the 1992 election now stands at 14.3 percent and the projected Labour majority is now 221," the newspaper said in a statement.
The newspaper said the rolling poll, based on interviews with a sample of 1,025 voters interviewed by telephone, will be updated every day until the May 1 election.
